frontmatter.name: KromaLedger
frontmatter.description: Local-first mobile expense, subscription, and invoice tracker

nodes.label: Deterministic Reconciliation Cycle
nodes.rationale: Idempotent catch-up calculation for recurring subscriptions and overdue invoices on boot and foreground

nodes.label: Minor-Unit Integer Money Math
nodes.rationale: Avoid floating-point currency drift by calculating in integer cents

nodes.label: Offline Double-Entry Ledger
nodes.rationale: Maintain balanced transaction records locally with strict accounting conventions

nodes.label: Atomic ZIP Vault Restore
nodes.rationale: Restore db-dump and binary attachments in single database transaction without partial state corruption

nodes.label: Local-First Vault Architecture
nodes.rationale: Keep receipts and database entirely on device with IndexedDB and ZIP export/restore

nodes.label: Portability Rule (75%+ in core/state)
nodes.rationale: Core calculation and state must remain decoupled from DOM and browser globals
